mapper.select: SELECT benefit_id, card_type, store_name, latitude, longitude, description FROM benefits ORDER BY card_type, benefit_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefits (benefit_id, card_type, store_name, latitude, longitude, description) VALUES ( SUBSTR(#{cardType}, 1, 3) || LPAD(NVL((SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(benefit_id, 3))) FROM benefits WHERE SUBSTR(benefit_id, 1, 2) = SUBSTR(#{cardType}, 1, 2)), 0) + 1, 4, '0'), #{cardType}, #{storeName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{description} )
